REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

(CONSULTING SERVICES – CONSULTANCY FIRM)

ALBANIA

Project: National Water Supply and Sanitation Sector Modernization Program (P4R)

TF No.: B8448

Assignment Title: Technical Assistance to support day to day management of Regional Water Utilities on financial issues.

Reference No.: AL-AKUK – 329911-CS-CQS

Albania is implementing governance and service reforms in the WSS sector supported by the World Bank through P4R project financed by SECO (Swiss Government). In parallel, structural reform changes are being launched by the government, including the creation of the new Water Production Operator (OPU) while the details of its future role and structure are still evolving; therefore this assignment shall focus on AKUK’s current mandate and existing institutional set-up, and reflect OPU-related interfaces only where and when formally clarified or necessary as working assumptions.

This Request for Expressions of Interest aims to assist AKUK in hiring a Consultant to support the Regional Water Utility (RWU) in strengthening its financial management, financial reporting, and financial sustainability through improvements in financial planning, budgeting, revenue management, regulatory compliance, and institutional capacity.

The detailed Terms of Reference (ToR) for the assignment can be found at the following website: https://akuk.gov.al/

The activities described in these TORs are expected to be completed within a period of 9 months, following the signing of the consultancy contract.

The assignment requires a firm which can demonstrate a minimum of 10 years of general consulting experience.

  • The firm’s specific experience should include at least three experiences in institutional strengthening support to water supply and sanitation utilities
  • Specific experience in Albania and countries in the Western Balkans region will be considered an advantage.

No.

Key expert

Qualifications and skills

1

Team Leader

  • Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Management, Public Administration, Engineering, or another relevant field.
  • Fluent in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong managerial and coordination skills.
  • Minimum 10 years of professional experience.
  • At least 7 years of experience leading institutional strengthening or financial management assignments in the water sector or other public utility sectors.
  • At least 5 years of experience as Team Leader or Project Manager on similar assignments.
  • Previous experience in Albania and/or the Western Balkans water sector will be considered an advantage.

2

Senior Financial Management Expert

  • Master’s degree in Management, Business Management, Engineering, Finance, Economics, or related field.  
  • At least 10 years of experience of assessing water and sanitation utilities’ organizational structure, staffing, capacity, resources, and equipment, and of recommending utility restructuring/reorganization.  
  • Strong understanding and experience with the regulatory framework governing the Albanian water supply and sanitation sector
  • Prior experience in projects within the Albanian water and sanitation sector or similar local contexts will be considered a significant advantage

3

Capacity Building and Training Specialist

  • Master's degree in Management, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Human Resources Development, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in developing and delivering training programs.
  • Experience in institutional capacity building.
  • Experience preparing manuals, operational procedures, and training materials.
  • Previous experience with public utilities will be considered an advantage.

 

The service will be selected under the provisions of the World Bank Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers (Procurement Regulations), in investment project financing Goods, Works, Non-Consulting and Consulting Services November 2020, in accordance with Consultant’s Qualifications Based Selection (CQS), Lump-Sum Contract. procnotices.bid_description: Social/Resettlement Specialist (Zambezia)
procnotices.contact_address: Mozambique
procnotices.notice_text:
Country: Republic of Mozambique

Name of Project:  Mozambique Safer Roads for Socio-Economic Integration (SRSEI) PROGRAM

Grant number:    IDA-E0780

Job title: Social/Resettlement Specialist (Zambezia)

Reference Number: MZ-PMU-559431-CS-INDV (Zambezia)

The Government of Mozambique, represented by the Ministry of Transport and Logistics (MTL), has received funding from the World Bank for the Mozambique Safer Roads for Socio-Economic Integration (SRSEI) and intends to apply part of the resources to consulting services.

The consulting services ("the Services") involve serving as the focal point of all Social risk management aspects of the Project. He/She will ensure Project implementation complies with the World Bank Social Standards under the ESF, on assessment and management of project social risks; labour and working conditions; community health and safety; land acquisition or restriction on land use and involuntary resettlement, stakeholder engagement and information disclosure and Gender Based Violence (GBV), Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (SEA) and Sexual Harassment (SH). 

The specific tasks of the SRS, will be undertaken in close coordination with units of SRSEI Program, ANE, and Local governments, Private sector, NGO’s and Community-based organizations staff responsible for the implementation of the Project activities. The expected duration of the project is 24 months. There will be a probationary period of 3 months from the date of signing the contract. The contract will be renewed upon satisfactory performance. The SRS will report to the Project Coordinator as leader of the PIU, which is directly subordinated to the PMU.

The detailed Terms of Reference (ToR) for the assignment can be obtained at the following Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1YM2-fkx79BChRhBf4mcEm6t77ENil7DS/view?usp=sharing

The Ministry of Transport and Logistics (MTL) now invites qualified individuals ("Consultants") to express their interest in providing the Services. Expressions of interest must include the following: (i) a CV detailing qualifications, work experience and achievements in comparable work; (ii) a cover letter, no more than two pages long, specifically addressing how the applicant fulfills each of the mandatory selection criteria listed below. It is mandatory to specify the reference number and the job title, for the EOI to be considered.The criteria for selecting the Consultant are found in section 4 of the Terms of reference.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn  to paragraphs 3.14, 3.16 and 3.17 of the World Bank's Procurement Rules for IPF Borrowers of September 2025 ("the Rules"), which sets forth the Bank's policy on conflict of interest.

For more information, please visit the address below during office hours from 8:30 a.m. to 3 p.m.

Submissions of Interest in Portuguese and English must be sent in writing to the address below (by e-mail) by 15:00 hours on August 20, 2026, local time, CAT/UTC +2.

  1. The Government of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Lowlands Livelihood Resilience Project – Phase Two (LLRP-II), and intends to apply part of the proceeds toward payments under the contract for the Construction of the 61.5 km Hamedela (Berhale) – Adokwa (Dalol) DC-2 Gravel Road and Bridges.
  2. The Afar National Regional State, Office of the President, Lowlands Livelihood Resilience Project – Phase Two (LLRP-II), Regional Project Coordination Unit, now invites sealed Bids from eligible Bidders for the Construction of the 61.5 km Hamedela (Berhale) – Adokwa (Dalol) DC-2 gravel road and bridges in Afar National Regional State, Ethiopia, divided into three lots: Lot 1: Hamedela (0+000) – Ayshit (25+000); Lot 2: Ayshit (25+000) – Simbilali (43+000); and Lot 3: Simbilali (43+000) – Adokwa (61+500).
  3. Bidding will be conducted through the national competitive bidding procurement using a request for bids (RFB) as specified in the World Bank's "Procurement Regulations ": "Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers - Procurement in Investment Project Financing, Goods, Works, Non-Consulting, and Consulting Services", dated September 2025 edition (hereinafter called "Regulation") and "Guidelines on Preventing and Combating Fraud and Corruption in Projects Financed by IBRD Loans and IDA Credits and Grants", dated July 1, 2016 and September 2023 (Anti-Corruption Guidelines); and other provisions stipulated in the financing agreements.

Bids will be publicly opened in the presence of the bidders' designated representatives and anyone who chooses to attend at the address below on September 04, 2026, 10:00 a.m. (morning).

procnotices.notice_text:
Request for Quotations

UKRAINE

Project:

Ukraine Improving Higher Education for Results Project (UIHERP)

Loan No.:

9238-UA

Name of the Procurement:

Procurement of Equipment for the Marine Educational and Research Center of Experimental Studies of Odesa I.I. Mechnikov National University

Procurement No.:

MOES-UIHERP-C2-MERGERS-82

1. Ukraine received the Loan No. 9238-UA from the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) in US dollars to finance the Ukraine Improving Higher Education for Results Project and intends to use part of the funds to make payments under the Contract No. MOES-UIHERP-C2-MERGERS-82 “Procurement of Equipment for the Marine Educational and Research Center of Experimental Studies of Odesa I.I. Mechnikov National University”.

2. The Ministry of Education and Science of Ukraine invites eligible participants to submit proposals for the supply of the equipment for the marine educational and research center, namely:

  • Multiparameter sonde
  • Single-point Doppler current meter with temperature and pressure sensors
  • Current velocity meter
  • CTD profiler
  • Sound velocity profiler
  • Single-beam echo sounder
  • Shallow-water side-scan sonar
  • Workstation
  • Software

More detailed information is provided in the Technical Specification.

The expected duration of the supply of goods is 150 (one hundred fifty) days from the date of signing the contract.

3. The World Bank requires compliance with the Bank’s Anti-Corruption Guidelines and its applicable sanctions policies and procedures, as outlined in the World Bank Group Sanctions Framework. In further compliance with this policy, Bidders shall permit and require their agents (whether declared or not), subcontractors, sub-consultants, service providers, suppliers and personnel to permit the Bank to inspect all invoices, records and other documents relating to the request for quotations and execution of the contract (in case of award), as well as for their verification by auditors appointed by the Bank.

4. The participant provides at least the following additional documents as part of the offer:

  • Manufacturer’s authorization for the offered equipment (if applicable);
  • Information on the local authorized service department/company.

More detailed information is given in the Request for Quotations.

5. This is a national bidding procedure, and bids shall be submitted through any registered Prozorro platform. More information on how to register on Prozorro is available at the following link: https://infobox.prozorro.org/upload/files/main/2038/613/guide-for-non-residents-1502-2.pdf 

6. Interested eligible participants can receive additional information, a complete set of documentation, including the technical specification, the proposal submission form and the contract form, as well as information on terms of submission of proposals by following the link in the electronic procurement system Prozorro: https://prozorro.gov.ua/uk/tender/UA-2026-08-05-006833-a
